newsitem.title: ITALY: Zanussi saw tax weighing on 1996 profit, sales off.
newsitem.headline: Zanussi saw tax weighing on 1996 profit, sales off.

text.p: Italian household electrical goods producer Zanussi posted 1996 net profit of 175 billion lire ($103.3 million), 22 percent down on the previous year, with turnover down 3.5 percent to 5.024 trillion lire, a statament from its Swedish parent AB Electrolux said.
But the pre-tax profit was more or less unchanged, the statement said adding that tax charges were 35.6 billion lire higher, but without giving further details.
Fixed investments were up 19.2 percent at over 273 billion lire while total debt rose to 400 billion lire from 291 billion in 1995.

The statement said 1996 had been a year of "consolidation" for Zanussi which "again saw results above the sector average, especially in a context of strong and continuing negativity in the household electrical goods sector."
Turnover would have risen to 5.30 trillion lire if the Italian currency had maintained its 1995 values, the statement added.
Electrolux has said its announced restructuring plan, envisaging 12,000 job cuts in Europe, did not for the moment foresee the closure of plants in Italy.
